what: An owner's budget shared by two agents, run live on Base Sepolia (test network), stake mode.
source: The owner-budget end-to-end run receipt of 2026-11-16 (operator report). Each transaction below was re-read from the chain on 2026-11-16: status 1, chain 84532, USDC transfers as listed. A second reviewer replayed the chain record independently and found the same.

moved.step: The owner put 1.0 into the shared budget
Agent 1 spent 0.3, in a race with agent 2
The owner took back the 0.1 left

refused.what: An agent that was never bound to the owner tried a real spend
The owner's signed spend limit was sent a second time
A spend from an empty budget
The same deposit was claimed twice
Agent 2 asked for 0.6, inside its own 1.0 limit, with only 0.4 left in the shared budget (once as a dry run, once for real)
Both agents asked for 0.3 at the same instant with 0.4 left: one was paid, the other refused
Agent 1 tried to spend after the owner set its limit to 0
Agent 2 tried to spend after the owner unbound it
The owner asked to withdraw a second time

not_shown: Not the newcomer path: the owner ran it from a script, not from this site.
No reputation moved: this run wrote no RepID or ERC-8004 feedback.
Test network only: test USDC, no real money.
The engine signed the agents' spends from the budget, as stake mode is designed to. The agents never held the funds.
